Hi all — quick tax note from Redwood's side:

- Since GreenBridge will be invoiced to the US legal entity, standard US tax handling (no VAT) applies. However, if any portion of services is later attributed to the UK (e.g., local seat usage), we will need the following evidence from GreenBridge to support zero-rating or appropriate VAT handling:
  * UK VAT registration number for the receiving entity
  * Local tax representative confirmation (if applicable)
  * Invoices should include a clear service description and country allocation if split billing is required

- Please upload: VAT_certificate_GreenBridge.pdf (if you have a UK VAT cert) or confirm that none exists. I attached a short checklist for our records: vat_evidence_checklist.docx.

- On the annual prepay flow: we are fine issuing the gross invoice and providing monthly drawdown memos. For auditability we will:
  1) Include the PO on every document
  2) Timestamp each drawdown memo and post to a shared folder (we can provide a CSV ledger each month)
  3) Keep VAT evidence attached to the annual contract folder for 7 years per policy

If GreenBridge would like Redwood to split invoices by country we can add that to the amendment; otherwise the single-entity flow is simplest.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Tax Analyst
